thread:
sophie: Quick thread  finish copy for three-mode landing + webinar promo + exact Growth routing. Keep everything short.

marta: Goal: three distinct hero verbs — Launch (Hosted), Commit (Dedicated), Control (Private). One microline per mode that focuses on customer outcome.

gabe: Draft heroes:
- Hosted: 'Launch fast. Predictable inference for your first million requests.'
- Dedicated: 'Commit capacity. Predictable latency, reserved throughput.'
- Private: 'Keep it in-house. Network, keys, and logs under your control.'

olivia: Webinar promo (short): 'Live benchmark + rollout demo: latency, per-token cost, and safe fallbacks.' Two CTAs to test: 'Reserve spot' and 'Download benchmark'.

patrick: Growth routing snippet (to paste into form rules):

```
if interest == "hosted": route -> queue:sdr-hosted
if interest == "dedicated": route -> queue:sdr-dedicated
if interest == "private": route -> queue:sdr-enterprise
if utm_campaign contains "webinar": add_tag:webinar
hidden_field: benchmark_pdf_opt_in = true
if interest=="private" and company_size >= 500: set_flag:needs-compliance-review
```

ken: Add 'primary_use_case' (chat, embeddings, search, batch) as optional field. APAC pages: avoid numeric latency in hero; use 'low-latency'.

marta: Feature bullets under each hero (3 bullets)
- 'Workload-aware batching & KV caching'
- 'Multi-variant routing for graceful fallbacks'
- 'Per-token telemetry & rollout controls'
Dedicated page reorder: lead with 'Reserved capacity & SLA'.

sophie: CTA mapping: Hosted -> 'Get started' (signup); Dedicated -> 'Request a pilot'; Private -> 'Request demo (security form)'.

gabe: I'll write the short modal script for the webinar landing: 2-3 sentences, narrative-first (customer problem), then what we'll show in the demo.

patrick: Owners: marta finalize copy by tomorrow; ken confirm any numbers or we use qualitative; gabe to prep webinar modal; growth ops (patrick) implement routing.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: copy-pass/tri-landing -> staging at 2024-11-01T20:00Z :white_check_mark:

sophie: I'll assemble PR with the three hero slabs, bullets, webinar modal, and Growth routing snippet. Tagging reviewers for final pass. :thumbsup:
